name: frontend-design
tagline_zh: 受够千篇一律的AI页面？这个Skill专治“模板脸”，用设计细节和创意代码，让每个组件都像手工定制，一眼难忘。
tagline_en: Tired of AI-generated pages that all look the same? This Skill kills the template face with crafted details and.
desc_en: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (examples include websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or when styling/beautifying any web UI). Generates creative, polished code and UI design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
why_zh: 它不堆组件库，而是从布局到微交互逐层定制，连阴影和间距都带设计意图，彻底摆脱AI味。
why_en: It skips generic component kits, customizing layout to micro-interactions with intentional shadows and spacing—zero AI clichés.
